Aang and The Guru

0:02

You hurt all these people.

آذَيْتَ كُلَّ هَؤُلَاءِ النَّاسَ.

0:04

Accept the truth.

تَقَبَّلِ الْحَقِيقَةَ.

0:06

Aang, these things happen, but don't let them hinder and poison your energy.

آنْج، هَذِهِ الْأَشْيَاءُ تَحْدُثُ، وَلَكِنْ لَا تَدَعْهَا تُعِيقُ وَتُسَمِّمُ طَاقَتَكَ.

0:12

If you want to be a positive energy in the world, then you must forgive yourself.

إِذَا أَرَدْتَ أَنْ تَكُونَ طَاقَةً إِيجَابِيَّةً فِي الْعَالَمِ، فَعَلَيْكَ أَنْ تُسَامِحَ نَفْسَكَ.

Privacy Policy

Last updated: 11 November 2026 · Contact: support@arabicwithm.com

1. Who we are

ArabicWithM (“we”, “us”) is a language-learning website offering interactive cartoons, graded books, audio and learning activities. This policy explains what personal data we collect when you use the service, why we use it, and the choices and rights you have.

2. Information we collect

Account information. When you register, we store your email address and authentication credentials. Passwords are handled by our authentication provider and are not stored by us in plain text. If you sign in with a social account, we may receive your name, email address and profile picture.

Profile information. You may provide a display name, username, avatar and banner image. Your profile visibility and reading-sharing preferences are also stored.

Learning and saved content. We record active learning time, word lookups, flashcard reviews, grammar and puzzle activity, streaks and goals. We store your saved words, My List selections, reading positions, bookmarks and audiobook progress so they can follow you between devices.

Content and communications. We retain feedback, reviews, corrections and other content you submit, as well as messages you send to us and our responses.

Payment information. Our payment processor handles your card and billing details. We do not see or store your full card number. We may receive your customer reference, payment and subscription status, amounts paid, and renewal or cancellation dates.

Technical and usage information. We may process your IP address, browser and device information, pages visited, interactions, diagnostic events and security logs. Essential cookies keep you signed in and protect the service. Browser storage also holds preferences, playback settings, guest usage allowances and temporary reading or feed state.

3. How we use information

We use information to provide and personalise the service, maintain your learning history, process payments, deliver account and service messages, respond to enquiries, improve content and features, keep the service secure, prevent abuse, and meet legal or accounting obligations.

Terms of Service

Last updated: 11 November 2026 · Contact: support@arabicwithm.com

1. Acceptance

By creating an account or using ArabicWithM, you agree to these terms. If you do not agree, please do not use the service.

2. The service

ArabicWithM provides Arabic-learning tools including interactive transcripts, vocabulary aids, grammar exercises, graded books, optional audio, flashcards and puzzles. Some features require an account, a paid AWM+ subscription or a complimentary access grant. Features and content may change as the service develops.

3. Accounts and profiles

Keep your sign-in credentials confidential, provide an accurate email address and do not share your account. You are responsible for activity under your account and for content you choose to make public.

You can manage your public-profile and reading-sharing settings on the site. You may ask us to delete your account by contacting support@arabicwithm.com. Account deletion does not by itself stop future subscription payments, so cancel any active renewal in your billing settings first or contact us for assistance.

4. Acceptable use

You agree not to scrape, crawl or bulk-download the site or its data (including transcripts and word lists) by automated means; bypass access controls or usage limits; probe, disrupt or overload the service; use it for anything unlawful; or submit content that is unlawful, abusive, misleading or infringes someone else’s rights. We may restrict or suspend accounts that abuse the service or put other users at risk.

5. Content and intellectual property

Content we create. Our original books, transcripts, translations, vocabulary lists, grammar exercises, illustrations, branding and puzzle data are owned by ArabicWithM or used under licence. We grant you a personal, non-exclusive, non-transferable licence to use them for your own learning. You may not copy, redistribute, republish, sell or create derivative works from them without written permission.

External media. Cartoon episodes and other embedded media belong to their respective owners and licensors. They are provided through external platforms for educational commentary and language instruction. We claim no ownership of, affiliation with, or endorsement by the underlying shows or rights holders.
